smoovplay.description: SmoovPlay enhances console gaming by leveraging your PC’s GPU for real-time AI frame generation and image upscaling. It interpolates additional frames between the original ones, transforming 30 FPS gameplay into a smoother 60, 90, or up to 120 FPS experience while improving image clarity and adapting the output to your display. Designed primarily for PS5 Remote Play, it also offers experimental support for capture cards, Xbox streaming, AMD Radeon, and Intel Arc GPUs. With customizable visual filters, instant replay recording, and adjustable performance settings, SmoovPlay delivers a smoother, sharper, and more customizable gaming experience without modifying your console.
